Implementation & services revenue (Forward Deployed Engineer becomes a category rather than a curiosity — 11+ FDE-titled openings in Zurich alone across OpenAI x2, Salesforce x5, Google, Rockstar, Ethon and ANYbotics, with Glassdoor reporting 24 Switzerland-wide; the consistent shape is customer-embedded LLM delivery, 25-50% travel and evals as a named deliverable)

Governance as a product line (SonarSource sells 'AI code verification and governance' and is hiring engineers to build circuit breakers, sandboxes and trust telemetry — governance hired for as product engineering, not compliance; AISPA audits 3,249 system-prompt instructions across 88 commercial products; BaFin gains AI supervision over banks and insurers)

Implementation & services revenue (the interesting number in the Stripe case study is the week, not the architecture — most enterprise agent programmes are measured in quarters because they start by building the harness; Forward Deployed Engineering acquires an Executive Director layer and Glassdoor's Swiss FDE count moves 24 → 40)

EU AI Act (the Commission's enforcement notice spells out chatbot-disclosure, deepfake-labelling and machine-readable-marking duties with fines to 3% of global turnover; practitioner post-mortems correct both opposite misreadings of the 2 August threshold and flag the underdiscussed vector that any third party — competitors included — can file a complaint an authority must act on)

Implementation & services revenue (Cognizant hires a Solution Architect for agentic AI and multi-agent systems across customer experience, supply chain, finance and HR in Zürich; InfoConsulting places an "AI Transformation & Enablement Lead"; the Swiss SI channel entering agentic AI is a demand-side indicator for every enterprise behind it)

EU AI Act (Chapter V enforcement live since 2 August with fines to 3% of global turnover, Anthropic turning Article 50 into a worldwide watermark default, German audit partners facing personal criminal exposure for agentic sign-off)

AI implementation & services revenue (Thrive Holdings raising $2B at $12B to run AI inside accounting and IT-services firms, Legora above $10B on ~$150M ARR, KPMG naming an AI-in-HR practice line, Accenture and EY consultant reqs in Zürich)

EU AI Act (Article 50 transparency duties are live with penalties to €15M or 3% of turnover, systems on market before 2 August have until 2 December for machine-readable marking — and the second-order effect is showing up in practice, with adversarial-testing documentation becoming a procurement requirement rather than a nice-to-have)
